description: This file is a shell script for testing a criss-cross merge scenario in a Git repository. It sets up multiple branches and commits, performs merges, and checks the results to verify correct merge behaviors.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file with the given index.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
